primaryLeftTargets.label: Reaper

fullBodyReferences.observation: Complete RE5 Reaper game render: two long antennae, four long hooked arms, wing/abdomen plates, luminous pale thorax and two lower jointed legs with hooked feet all end inside the frame. Entire insect support and scythe endpoints visible with margin.
fullBodyReferences.referenceKind: retained secondary appearance reference; no primary Capcom asset certification

primaryLeftTargets.label: Popokarimu

fullBodyReferences.observation: Complete brown RE5 Popokarimu concept body fits within frame including folded wing extremities, feet/claws, raised abdomen/tail and terminal appendages.
observations: Source illustration shows the entire low crouched creature: folded wings with terminal claws, head/mandibles, hind appendages and the raised segmented abdomen/tail ending inside the frame. It is an illustrated appearance reference, not raw mesh geometry.
limitations: Independent generating-agent review remains required; no original geometry, hidden surfaces or original idle animation is certified.

idle.reason: The2020head, chest and shoulders are visible, but side limbs and lower body are cut. No complete same-form claws, hind feet and rear contour established.
Only the root-wrapped head, shoulders and upper vine cage are visible. Lower root limbs, hands and foot/tendril termini leave the frame; the1998flower-Ivy is a different form.
An enlarged lateral limb/claw is cut at the left boundary; the full appendage perimeter is not documented. No image_gen body request was issued from insufficient original references.

The large crustacean limbs/abdomen and sharp lateral points extend outside the image; its extreme leg/equipment ends are not all documented. No image_gen body request was issued from insufficient original references.

The head/upper torso and some reaching limbs are shown, with limbs and rear body cut by the frame; no complete beta silhouette is verified. No image_gen body request was issued from insufficient original references.
